scope: Corollary 1.2 (Failure of universal Gaussian global existence) of the manuscript “Stable self-similar blowup for a supercritical defocusing Schrödinger equation on the torus” (preprints/Stable-Self-Similar-Blowup-for-a-Supercritical-Defocusing-Schrodinger-Equation-on-the-Torus-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 371 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 09887025fcf67354), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For the fixed power p and index k in Theorem 1.1, and for every α > k + 6, the initial datum uω 0 (x) = X n∈Z12 gn(ω)⟨n⟩−α ein·x (1.2) belongs to Hk almost surely and has positive probability of finite-time blowup. In particular, the following assertion is false: for every energy-supercritical pair (d, p) there is a finite α0(d, p) such that, for every α > α0(d, p) and every d/2 + 2 < m < α − d/2, the local Hm solution with the Gaussian datum extends almost surely to C(R; Hm(Td)).
